purpose: Define the minimum capture shape for future real usage evidence of S28/S29 domain governance packs without counting this template as real usage.

capture_contract.unavailable_policy: Unknown or absent observations must remain unavailable, not inferred.
capture_contract.real_usage_requirement: A record only counts as real usage evidence when applicability.evidence_source is real_work_slice and source_refs resolve to the reviewed Work Slice evidence.

recommended_when: A future Work Slice applies the AI Agent Security pack to prompt-injection or untrusted-content risk.
A future Work Slice applies the Web App Security pack to client/server, tenant, auth, secret, webhook or artifact boundary risk.
not_recommended_for: Retrofitting synthetic examples as real usage evidence.
